CASE FILE: MS-09
UNIT: DIGITAL EVIDENCE / ARCHIVE RECOVERY
STATUS: OPEN

An inspection photograph was recovered from the North Pier archive desk. The photograph opens normally, but the file is larger than expected for an image of this size.

A separate handover note is believed to have been stored with the photograph. The examiner suspects the export process left a clue in the image metadata and that the second item may be embedded after the visible image data.

OBJECTIVE
Recover the handover note and extract the recovery marker.

EXHIBIT A — archive_photo.jpg

INVESTIGATION LEADS
- Inspect the image metadata, especially the user comment field.
- The user comment appears to be encoded text rather than a sentence.
- Check whether data is appended after the JPEG image ends.

All evidence is included locally. No live service or external account is required.
